scope: Independent offline source, linked ELF, capacity, bounded arithmetic and bound mocked-ARM-result review of the new 1.50.10 drawer smooth variant. No hardware access, installation, Git operation or mutation of earlier frozen inputs.

capacity.strict_build_flags: -Wall -Wextra -Werror; fixed linker bounds and no undefined symbols
capacity.table_change: No new builtin-table change. The prior disabled wifi_recorder diagnostic entry remains required; source does not re-enable it. Preserve helper at 0x3804be70 and later bytes. Writer page/table-byte preservation is independently reviewed by installer.
capacity.qualification: Reuse the bound exact-image capacity audit for the 2960-byte diagnostic container plus 472-byte wifi_recorder worker. This is a bounded control-flow review, not a proof that arbitrary computed pointers never enter the overwritten region.

source_review.context: animation_from remains byte164 (+0xa4); pending and phase append at byte168 (+0xa8) and byte172 (+0xac). Earlier context offsets remain unchanged.
source_review.origin: begin chooses last valid admitted shown pose before background capture resets shown; otherwise logical cover. Origin phase0 is submitted first, and pending clears only after successful PAN and a fresh post-PAN CLOCK.
source_review.time_progress: Subsequent candidate phase adds min(unsigned current clock minus previous anchor,30), clamped150. Phase/anchor commit only after successful PAN and fresh CLOCK. Ordinary phase anchor uses pre-render candidate time, so the next phase includes prior rendering cost; initial origin alone uses fresh post-PAN time.
source_review.failures: Queue occupancy prevents proposal. Failed pre-frame CLOCK prevents interpolation. Failed PAN does not change shown, phase, pending or anchor. Failed post-PAN CLOCK leaves the admitted shown pose but preserves phase, pending and anchor; later monotonic recomputation re-admits an equal or later pose. Retarget uses admitted shown instead of any failed calculated cover.
source_review.rounding: Every animated phase proposal is submitted even when integer rounding repeats the visible pose. This avoids a one-pixel transition stalling before phase150.
source_review.finger_follow: While captured gesture.active is true, direct gesture cover is drawn without snap interpolation. Ordinary full-cover TAP only counts and dirties the counter; it does not create a pending overlay.
source_review.endpoint: Endpoint phase150 must be successfully admitted and clock-committed. Owner handoff is attempted only on a later queue-drained GUI cycle with both release scans and the publisher-locked final input gate.
source_review.contact_ownership: Existing whole-contact capture, other-stream guard, physical/virtual classification, and suppression of new contacts during snap remain unchanged. ABI state/continue offsets are +0x12/+0x13, list prev/next +0x80/+0x84.
source_review.display_lifetime: Both compositor and snapshot allocations remain alive. Original TIMER runs outside broker mutex. Snapshot is made in the GUI thread after original TIMER and only with queue0. Stock PAN/UPDATEAREA submits are suppressed during mode or overlay; compositor writes only at queue0 before native PAN synchronous staging copy and queue publication.
source_review.services: The short-lived bootstrap installs hooks then exits; original main runs once and stock UI/JS plus background services retain original lifecycle.

arithmetic_review.curve: 150ms smoothstep: from + signed_delta * t*t*(450-2*t)/3375000, t in [0,150]. Signed division truncates toward zero.
arithmetic_review.model_scope: Independent bounded integer arithmetic proof; separate from ARM instruction execution and hardware.
arithmetic_review.quantization_limit: Tiny moves may repeat pixel poses; five phase-progress submissions do not imply five distinct LCD-visible pictures.

bound_ARM_model_result.separation: Reviewed result and test source; the sibling executed actual linked ARM instructions with native APIs mocked. This review does not claim hardware execution or native IRQ/mutex/LCD cadence verification.

diagnosis_basis: Bound public ease timing summary is consistent with 1000 non-atomic samples: observed closing from shown233 to calculated114 with old elapsed25ms, and shown220 to calculated91 with old elapsed30ms. This supports a steep first displacement; it does not establish a fully expired 120ms animation or snap while finger held. No raw captures, identity or network configuration are reproduced here.
limits: No hardware execution, installation, cold boot or Mi Home validation of this new variant is established by this review. Prior ease hardware success does not transfer automatically.

Native PAN admission and software shown do not prove physical LCD scanout cadence. IRQ concurrency, native mutex internals and complete serialization of every direct mmap writer are outside mocked tests.
Nominal150ms phase is paced by successful submissions with a30ms cap; actual wall duration adapts to rendering, queues and scheduling and is not a150ms deadline.
Installer must preserve exact old baseline and unrelated page/table bytes. This program review is distinct from writer review and hardware verification.
Changing bound C, ELF, BIN, headers, build or test inputs invalidates this review association.
independent_review_result: No source, integer-capacity or unchanged final-handoff blocker found for the bound candidate. Hardware remains separately required.
